summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for $8.658 million aggregate principal amount of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due June 30, 2032, linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000, and EURO STOXX 50 indices. The notes are unsecured obligations under its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program, issued at $1,000 per Note. Terms include monthly contingent coupon payments, autocallability starting December 2026, and principal-at-risk maturity. This is an ordinary debt issuance, not a special situation.
